title: Relational Databases
resolved_source_points: The two supplied slide PDFs were byte-identical; the unique three-page document was rendered and inspected in full.
The transcript has no embedded timestamps, so concept and task ranges were mapped against the complete video.

The task wording first says to interrupt the process and later explicitly describes interrupting the database; the lab uses a disposable database-server crash and documents client interruption as a smaller variation.

tasks.purpose: Model a social-network schema, use a multi-statement transaction for a user and profile, interrupt the database before commit, and inspect whether partial state survives.
